note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SWI 9, 11, 12. 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 Ordinance on Swiss Citizenship; A06b SWI 9, 11, 12. 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 Ordinance on Swiss Citizenship; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Switzerland, 2024
